actions.action: Water thoroughly until water drains from holes
If soil is very dry, bottom-soak pot in basin for 20-30 minutes then drain
Move plant out of direct sun to bright indirect light
Cut off fully brown or crispy leaves at the base
Check plant in a day or two for perking up
Check top inch or two of soil is dry before watering again
If signs of overwatering, unpot and trim black mushy roots
If root rot, repot into fresh well-draining potting mix

reason: The answer identifies the peace lily as thirsty and sun-scorched and leads with thorough watering and moving it to bright indirect light, matching the confirmed fix, with nothing harmful.
